Objective: Audit initial SGCC dataset & generate executive summary
Outcome: Artificial perfect separation (F1=1.00) due to synthetic zero-injection fallback data

Objective: Acquire and validate genuine SGCC dataset (42,372 meters)
Outcome: Discovered lexicographical date sorting bug, 25.64% missing cells, 8.53% true positive rate

Objective: Audit missing gaps and formulate bounded imputation
Outcome: Found 5 fully-missing customers (dropped), bounded ffill(limit=7), train-only median imputer

Objective: Benchmark Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, XGBoost under Unweighted, Weighted, SMOTE
Outcome: Weighted XGBoost achieved top Val F1=0.4127, Test F1=0.3802. SMOTE yielded F1=0.3767 with higher train latency.

Objective: Optimize XGBoost hyperparameters with 5-fold Stratified CV & threshold grid
Outcome: Found optimal parameters (subsample=0.7, max_depth=7, n_estimators=200, reg_lambda=100); Test F1 improved to 0.402

Objective: Compute TreeSHAP values, evaluate feature groups, prune collinear features to 18
Outcome: Discovered missingness features rank #1 in SHAP importance; 18-feature model achieved Test F1=0.4014 (96.5% performance retained)

Objective: Evaluate feature selection stability across 5 folds and test 14-feature candidate
Outcome: 15 features had 100% selection stability; 14-feature model achieved Test F1=0.3647 (over-pruned predictive signal)

Objective: Stress test 18-feature vs 42-feature model against Gaussian noise, burst data loss, and synthetic evasion
Outcome: 18-feature model proved significantly more robust to noise and packet loss than 42-feature model due to lower collinear amplification

Objective: Ingest 370 customer 15-minute load records from LD2011_2014.txt and aggregate to hourly kWh load
Outcome: Identified 20.15% zero readings in 2011 due to progressive customer onboarding; produced clean hourly time-series

Objective: Engineer 29 strictly causal lag/rolling/calendar features and benchmark against Persistence, Seasonal, Linear, Ridge, RF, XGBoost
Outcome: XGBoost achieved Validation MAE=3,935.63 kWh, R2=0.9923; Naive Persistence MAE=14,066.68 kWh

Objective: 5-fold expanding window TimeSeriesSplit CV on 2011-2013 training data
Outcome: XGBoost Mean MAE=10,365.77 kWh with Std=10,204.25 kWh due to Fold-2 structural non-stationarity (2011 to 2012 load doubling)

Objective: Evaluate frozen XGBoost regressor once on sealed H2 2014 test set (4,416 hours)
Outcome: Achieved Test MAE=4,503.51 kWh (or 4,421.55 kWh on trimmed 4,392h window), RMSE=6,743.21 kWh, R2=0.9942, sMAPE=1.98%

Objective: Implement low-latency REST API serving both frozen models with zero runtime leakage and Pydantic validation
Outcome: Sub-10ms inference latency, 100% pass rate across 13 integration tests in test_api_endpoints.py

Objective: Develop single-page application with React 19, TypeScript, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, live API telemetry
Features: Meter inspection, CSV batch upload, hourly load forecasting, telemetry dashboards
Outcome: Full frontend-backend integration verified, resolved Vite Tailwind plugin styling conflict

Objective: Evaluate LightGBM, Optuna tuning, domain interaction ratios, EMA/Fourier features under double-sealed protocol
Outcome: SGCC: Frozen XGBoost beat all LightGBM candidates (0.3592 vs 0.3366). UCI: LightGBM improved MAE by 3.4% but required stateful EMA caching. Baseline retained.

Objective: Implement custom Focal Loss objective (gamma=2.0, alpha=0.85) in LightGBM and evaluate threshold operating curve
Outcome: LightGBM Focal Loss achieved Test F1=0.4479, Test PR-AUC=0.4178 (+34.2% lift), ROC-AUC=0.8429; serialized artifact generated

Objective: Exhaustive programmatic audit of class overlap, missingness ablation, data quality groups, learning curves
Features: 18 features vs 42 features vs 15 consumption vs 3 missingness
Outcome: Confirmed >95% empirical overlap in consumption features; learning curves hit plateau at N=23,000; missingness carries significant signal
